contests.title: Wellington Bays: Labour against the Greens

seats.name: Wellington Bays
seats.note: Wellington Bays is new in 2026. Its past results here are notional, all of Rongotai's votes and those cast at Wellington Central's voting places in Brooklyn and Mount Cook, which is where the boundary review took it from. People can vote anywhere, so voting places only approximate the area. Julie Anne Genter won Rongotai from Labour in 2023.

backtest.label: Seat's swing at the last election

assumed_seats.note: Te Pāti Māori leads the Greens by 436. In 2023 special votes moved this seat about 1,000 votes towards Te Pāti Māori; the party's domestic special votes have leaned its way more than the Greens' have.
ACT's David Seymour leads National's Paul Goldsmith by 2,044.
Te Pāti Māori's Rawiri Waititi leads the Greens by 2,274.
